method.asset_radius: Maximum Euclidean norm of every binary-little-endian float32 PLY vertex in the registered design-screening storage frame; outward ceiling to 1e-9 mm
method.conservatism: Triangle inequality and revolute arc-length bound; constant spacecraft mount rotation/translation cannot increase Hausdorff distance
method.full_locus_radius: asset radius plus maximum declared prismatic scene offset where applicable; no Owner scene value selected
method.joint_coefficient: full-locus radius plus the sum of Euclidean norms of every downstream URDF joint-origin translation through the registered frame; outward ceiling to 1e-9 mm/rad
method.prohibited_use: Candidate vectors may not be loaded by the system edge oracle until an operational asset is promoted and a new system certificate is independently issued
